# Golden expected-edges fixture: tests/fixtures/golden/csharp
#
# Format, xfail marker, resolution-kind column and scope: see
# tests/fixtures/golden/python/expected_edges.txt and tests/common/golden.rs.
# Only CALLS edges are scored.
#
# Baseline measured 2026-09-23: precision 1.0 (10/10), recall 1.0 (10/10),
# 1 known-failing line.

# Plain call to a same-class private static method. Golden.Other.Helper
# has a same-named LocalUtil decoy.
Golden.App.Caller.Entry CALLS Golden.App.Caller.LocalUtil exact

# `using Golden.Helpers` then Helper.FormatGreeting. Golden.Other.Helper
# is a same-named class decoy.
Golden.App.Caller.CallImportedHelper CALLS Golden.Helpers.Helper.FormatGreeting import

# Fully qualified namespace path.
Golden.App.Caller.CallNamespacePath CALLS Golden.Helpers.Helper.FormatGreeting exact

# Method call on this. LoudGreeter.Format is a same-named decoy.
Golden.Greeting.Greeter.Greet CALLS Golden.Greeting.Greeter.Format exact

# Receiver-typed call. LoudGreeter.Greet is a same-named decoy.
Golden.App.Caller.CallReceiverTyped CALLS Golden.Greeting.Greeter.Greet receiver_type

# Inherited method call: Dog : Animal, no Speak override. Cat.Speak is a
# same-named decoy.
Golden.App.Caller.CallInherited CALLS Golden.Animals.Animal.Speak inherited

# Interface call through ISpeaker. Cat.Say is a same-named decoy.
Golden.App.Caller.CallInterface CALLS Golden.Animals.ISpeaker.Say receiver_type

# Ambiguous class name: Runner exists in Golden.Ambiguous.A and .B; the
# using picks A.
Golden.App.Caller.CallAmbiguous CALLS Golden.Ambiguous.A.Runner.Run  # xfail: receiver type Runner is ambiguous and usings are not used to disambiguate it

# External call: System.Console is never indexed.
Golden.App.Caller.CallExternal CALLS UNRESOLVED

# Private static helper in the same class.
Golden.Helpers.Helper.FormatGreeting CALLS Golden.Helpers.Helper.Decorate exact

# Cross-file incoming call into Caller.Entry.
Golden.Downstream.Downstream.UseEntry CALLS Golden.App.Caller.Entry receiver_type
